texts.preamble: In Re:- Narayan Maity vs Re: An Application For Bail Under ... on 24 June, 2016 Author: Ashim Kumar Roy Bench: Ashim Kumar Roy 1 69 24.6.2016 pd. C.R.M. No. 4820 of 2016 In re:- Narayan Maity ... Petitioner.
texts.facts: The petitioner is in custody for 8 months and out of nine chargesheeted-accused persons, two are on bail.
texts.arguments: The learned Counsel for the petitioner in his usual fairness submits that he never claimed that this petitioner is standing on the same footing with the other co-accused, who were granted bail by this Court. It is his further submission that this is a case of consumption of spurious and poisonous country liquor and as a result thereof, total 23 persons died.
texts.petitioner_arguments: The learned Counsel for the petitioner in his usual fairness submits that he never claimed that this petitioner is standing on the same footing with the other co-accused, who were granted bail by this Court.
